info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Miles-v1-spec
info.description: The Miles Accumulation Inquiry API allows users to access and retrieve detailed information about airline flights and their corresponding mileage. This endpoint serves to enhance customer experience by providing insights into the mileage accumulated from various flights. It is beneficial for travelers looking to track or redeem their frequent flyer miles efficiently. Ideal consumers of this API include travel agencies, airline service providers, and frequent flyers who wish to monitor their mileage status.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the mileage details for a specific flight. Utilize this information to understand how many miles can be earned or redeemed based on your journey.
